properties.evidence: This 2026-08-22 measurement saw the proposal's central weakness coming, six days early and from real work rather than from reasoning: a root cause was already recorded and findable by the error string, and a session re-derived it from scratch anyway. Its conclusion — "the gap is not accumulation, it is SURFACING" — is the argument that a METHOD may not be the missing piece, which is exactly what this Decision has to weigh.
